title: Computation Note on the Monthly Late Charge — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**The charge.** Under the Contingency Placement Agreements, a late charge on a past-due fee invoice is the tier's late-charge percent per month of the invoice's unpaid amount, and at least the tier's late-charge minimum, rounded to the cent.

**The unpaid amount.** The invoice's unpaid amount is the invoice amount less the fee payments and fee credits applied to that invoice, and never less than zero.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Invoice amount | the fee invoice entry in the agreement's client money history, by its invoice number |
| Fee payments applied to the invoice | the fee payment entries carrying that invoice number |
| Fee credits applied to the invoice | the fee credit entries carrying that invoice number |
| Late-charge percent per month | the tier figure of the agreement's tier |
| Late-charge minimum | the tier figure of the agreement's tier |

## Structure of the figure

1. The unpaid amount is the invoice amount, less the fee payments applied to the invoice, less the fee credits applied to it; a result below zero counts as zero.
2. The percentage charge is the unpaid amount multiplied by the tier's late-charge percent per month.
3. The charge is the higher of the percentage charge and the tier's late-charge minimum.
4. The charge is rounded to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Tier figures used for illustration: 1.5 percent per month and a minimum of 5.00 USD.

| Invoice amount | Payments applied | Credits applied | Unpaid amount | Percentage charge | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2400.00 | 600.00 | 150.00 | 1650.00 | 24.75 | 24.75 USD |
| 2000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2000.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 USD |
| 500.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 | 200.00 | 3.00 | 5.00 USD (the minimum) |
| 1333.33 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1333.33 | 19.99995 | 20.00 USD |

On a tier whose minimum is 0.00 USD, the charge on an unpaid amount of 200.00 USD at 1.0 percent per month is 2.00 USD.
